purpose: Screen current vendor DeepSeek4 source and local artifacts for a non-duplicate mechanism that could plausibly reach 10 tok/s after the MMVQ hot skip rejection, before any runtime patch.

constraints: France answer must remain semantically correct and coherent

source_grep: src/llama-model.cpp contains NextN/MTP metadata loading and comments, but DeepSeek4 runtime support is not implemented for target verification.
src/llama-arch.cpp says NextN/MTP tensors are currently ignored/reserved for future MTP support.

src/models/deepseek4.cpp exposes LLAMA_DEEPSEEK4_LIGHTNING_INDEXER, DS4_HOT_DISPATCH, and DS4_SPARSE_RETAINED_GRAPH_PROBE_OUT, but build_expert_mix receives selected IDs and weights, not a retained gate output tensor.

ggml/src/ggml-backend.cpp has GGML_SCHED_MOE_CACHE_PREFETCH=setmarkov, but the cache copies experts for the current backend slot path and does not provide a proven cross-layer predictive source overlap for the accepted DeepSeek4 cold path.
common/speculative.cpp and examples/speculative require a compatible draft model for normal speculation; no local compatible DeepSeek draft exists.
inspection_evidence.local_model_conclusion: No local tokenizer-compatible DeepSeek draft/MTP GGUF was found. GLM shards are not a compatible DeepSeek draft model.

candidate_screens.reason: Current vendor source preserves/loads some NextN/MTP metadata in generic/model-loader paths, but DeepSeek4 target verification is not implemented and the accepted DeepSeek GGUF has no local draft/MTP companion. Without a compatible draft and verifier, correctness cannot be guaranteed.

candidate_screens.candidate: no-source verifier/speculation preserving greedy token stream
candidate_screens.reason: Lookahead/ngram/lookup mechanisms exist, but historical DeepSeek4 runs either diverged, stalled/replayed, accepted too few drafted tokens, or ran below SOTA. llama-results top1 is only a verifier and provides no speedup by itself.

candidate_screens.candidate: compact resident representation for exact GPU up/down
candidate_screens.reason: Existing DS4_HOT_DISPATCH is rectangular and gate-recompute based. Sparse retained probe showed no retained graph-level gate output available to build_expert_mix, no active hot manager path in the accepted route, and final combine/copy margin is too tight. Existing Q8_0/MMVQ/raw/transposed/row-tile probes failed correctness or bandwidth bounds.

candidate_screens.candidate: predictive async source overlap before the consuming op/layer
candidate_screens.reason: Accepted path source/page exposure is large, but source-only overlap has a zero-overhead ceiling below 10 tok/s. Existing same-op touch, mmap/direct staging, io_uring/source-only prefetch, and backend MoE slot prefetch do not remove enough decode CPU up/down fallback under the strict cold 16GB page-cache budget.

next_required_work: Do not repeat closed cache-size, source-only, DS4_HOT rectangular, raw/transposed/row-tile, Q8_0, MMVQ, lightning, CUDA graph, lookahead, or ngram routes.
A future runtime patch must start from a new hard-bound artifact, not from source editing.

The next plausible 10 tok/s path requires either a compatible DeepSeek draft/MTP artifact plus target-verifier integration, or a new exact compact representation design that proves source bytes, compute bandwidth, VRAM, host RAM/page-cache, TTFT, and fixed-text top1 correctness before benchmarking.
